title: Choose the visual world for Placement Readiness
question: The roll assigned Module Booklets. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Module Booklets
options.lineage: coaching-institute study modules: colour-coded subject booklets with bold numbered covers
options.thesis: Preparation as a stack of numbered, colour-coded modules, the way every student already studied for JEE and campus tests.
options.viewport: Cobalt nav rail; header with greeting, theme switch, toasts; KPI strip; gaps and plan as numbered module spines in their cluster colours; readiness radar; drives table with eligibility and readiness in separate columns.
options.risk: Five hues can turn into a rainbow if clusters, not decoration, don't own them strictly.

raised.raise: One hue is reserved for 'your next step' only, the way the course purple rides over the terrain.
Every number is tabular and column-aligned: data density with nothing floating.
Each plan shows its hard time budget against the drive date, so it can't overflow the side.
Colour stays flat and unmodulated: no gradients, glass or glow anywhere.

options.label: Grade Card
options.lineage: university mark sheets and grade cards: ruled columns, seal maroon, institutional navy
options.thesis: Readiness issued like an official record: ruled, certified, and stamped when earned.
options.viewport: Navy top bar with crest mark; dashboard as a ruled grade card of skills and dimensions; a maroon 'Ready' stamp on drives where readiness passes the threshold.
options.risk: Familiar and formal: it can read bureaucratic, the direction most runs for an institution land on.

options.label: Manual Tab Board
options.lineage: boxed-software manuals with coloured divider tabs
options.thesis: The app as a tabbed reference manual: each section owns a divider hue on a stepped tab rail.
options.viewport: Stepped tab rail down the right edge (Dashboard, Evidence, Drives, Plan); the current section's hue floods the board behind white content leaves.
options.case: Fuses well: sections map to tabs and navigation gets clearer; loses on audience identification.
options.risk: Full-strength section hues can tire the eye on long officer sessions.

options.label: Title Card Wall
options.thesis: Drives browsed like a streaming wall: the focused tile grows to show your match and eligibility.
options.viewport: Rows of drive and skill tiles; the focused drive expands to show eligibility and readiness chips while the rest dims.
options.case: Fuses for students (instantly familiar); loses clarity for dense officer tables.
options.risk: Pulls toward entertainment; dark-first grounds edge toward the look you ruled out.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: Your preparation as a purple course over the skill terrain.
options.viewport: Skill terrain map with the plan drawn as a numbered purple course.
options.case: Fuses poorly: students don't identify with orienteering, and the map obscures tables.
options.risk: A picture of a map instead of a working screen.
options.kept: One hue reserved exclusively for the active next step.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.thesis: Batch data as a strobing black-and-white barcode field.
options.viewport: Readiness distribution as a barcode wall.
options.case: Fuses poorly: cold, and close to the 'hacker' look you ruled out.
options.risk: Strobing is unacceptable on a working screen.

options.label: Mixtape J-Card
options.thesis: A plan inked like a tracklist that must fit the tape.
options.viewport: Plan as side A / side B tracklists with running times.
options.case: Fuses poorly: nostalgic, and handwriting hurts scanability.
options.kept: A hard time budget the plan can never overflow.

options.label: Garden Guide Map
options.thesis: Sections as swelling lobes of flat colour.
options.case: Fuses poorly: playful, overshooting motion conflicts with your brief.
options.kept: Flat, unmodulated colour: no gradients or glow.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A modern SaaS dashboard executed impeccably: neutral surfaces, one indigo accent, cards and a sidebar.
canonCard.viewport: White sidebar, KPI cards, charts and tables, as in Linear, Vercel or Stripe dashboards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other dashboard by design.
